utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Vik, I was just talking to Oren about the repair drive — sounds like we're getting things moving!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's right, Tess! I've been telling everyone—we're fixing park benches with Sam's tools and lumber. I think you mentioned lawnmowers too—it's going to be a big day!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I thought we were doing bikes and toasters — Oren mentioned those! But park benches sound great too, I can bring my gardening shears.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Pia, I hope we're still starting at 8 AM sharp on Saturday. I've got the water pump tools ready.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, 8 AM sharp. But I'm still worried we might be short on volunteers to manage the pickup and drop-off spots.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Don't you worry, Pia—I already asked Hana and Quinn if they could lend a hand with the logistics. They'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alright, bring it by Saturday morning. I'll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I'll bring the drive Saturday morning. See you then.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good. See you Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Jules, I heard about the repair drive this Saturday—do you think they'd be able to fix my old toaster?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, totally! Sam's got a whole crew of folks who can fix just about anything—bring it by the shed and we'll take a look!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's a relief—I've been using a butter knife to pry my toast out for weeks!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, yes—the repair drive is this Saturday at the community center from 10 to 4. I have a flyer if you need one.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, Saturday from 10 to 4! I'll be there—should I bring my toolbox?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yes, definitely bring your toolbox! The flyer says to bring any tools you're comfortable using.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Cleo! Have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old playground, and it'll be a great chance to get together!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I've been sorting supplies for it! We're short on paint and sandpaper, so we'll need a few folks to bring those.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, good thinking, Cleo! I'll ask around and see if anyone can bring extra paint and sandpaper—maybe I can rally a few more neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sorry, Hana, I don't have the part on me—I'll check the supply shed later today, but I wanted to ask Dane first if he's got it covered.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Opal. What part are we talking about? I might have it in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's for the water pump repair—do you have a replacement part in your garage?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Actually, I was clarifying—we're talking about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday, not a specific tool. Do you have a wrench you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: A wrench? Uh, I think I have one somewhere—let me check my garage, it might be buried under some old flyers.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Noah! Let me know if you need help digging through your garage—I'm free this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, the repair drive? I've been meaning to ask about that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, we're fixing up the park benches and the old playground this Saturday. We could really use your help if you're free!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'll be there. Got a couple of my own things to look at too, actually.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Cleo, just give me the quick list and I'll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I've got some screws and a wrench set if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Alright, Ira, bring 'em by. Just don't let Kira talk you into swapping for left-handed wrenches again.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I'm putting together a repair drive next Saturday. Got something that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Gus, I'm so glad you mentioned it — I just got word that we've moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center instead.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Oh, that's good to know, Rosa — I'll spread the word and make sure folks like Nell and Tess are clued in about the Sunday change.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey there, Faye! Just the person I wanted to see — we got the gym roof patched and the playground lights rewired, and everything passed inspection. Want to come take a look later?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great news, Mara! I'd love to see it — and it sounds like the timing worked out perfectly with the school pickup schedule.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It really did, Faye! I made sure we scheduled everything around when the kids get out, so no one had to worry about traffic or noise.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Cleo, are you free this Saturday to help with the water pump repair?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, I'm already deep in the supply list for the repair drive, but I can definitely make time for the water pump. Count me in.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll add you to the schedule. We're meeting at the pump house at 9 a.m. sharp.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Faye, still on for Saturday morning at my garage?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, Saturday morning works. I just need to make sure we wrap up by 3 PM for school pickup.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure, 3 PM works. I'll have tools ready by 8.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, then. I'll see you Saturday morning, same as always.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, Eli! I'll be there too — Sam's got a whole crew ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that's what I like to hear. Steady hands and a set schedule — we'll have that drive running smooth by noon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Next Saturday, you said? I'll have to check my schedule, but I'll do my best to make it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait—Uli, I think it's actually this Saturday, not next Saturday. Sorry, I keep mixing up the dates.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, this Saturday? That's sooner than I thought—I might need to rearrange a few things.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, so is it still Saturday morning at your garage?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh no, Mina, we had to shift it! It's now Sunday at the community center instead—hope that still works for you.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday works for me. What time at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Tess, I'm actually the one organizing it over at my garage. Nell's already on board with her toaster—you should swing by too if something's busted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, Gus is a real pro with electronics—I'm bringing my toaster on Saturday. You should come, Tess!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That's right, Tess—I've got a workbench set up and plenty of tools. What do you need fixed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Do you want to stop by my place and grab a flyer? I've got one right by the door.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I'll swing by in a bit. Thanks for having one ready.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I'll leave it on the porch for you. See you soon!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, everyone. What's the status on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, Dane! We're all set for next Saturday—fixing up the park benches with Sam's tools and lumber. We'll need duct tape and hammers, so bring 'em if you've got 'em!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can bring a hammer and some duct tape. Where exactly are we meeting?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: So far, so good, Dane — we got the gym roof patched and the playground lights rewired, and everything passed inspection. I think we're making real progress.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mara! Speaking of progress, have you heard about our repair drive this Saturday? We're fixing up the old playground!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, Quinn, that's wonderful! I already helped with the playground lights, but I'll be there Saturday to lend a hand with whatever else needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Faye, yes, I’ve been thinking about that—the school pickup times are tight, so we really need to double-check the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I thought we were talking about school pickups. I'm a bit lost—did you say something about fixing bikes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: No, Oren, the repair drive is for fixing small appliances and such, not just bikes. We're trying to align it with school hours so parents can drop off items.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Tess, just to confirm, we're talking about the water pump repair drive this Saturday, right? And do you have that wrench that fits the bolt sizes on the sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, right, the water pump drive! I think I have an old adjustable wrench in my garage—lemme check and I'll bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Great, thanks Tess! If it's adjustable, just double-check it covers the sizes on the list, especially the 3/4-inch and 1-inch bolts.
